manual.meaning: The documented option only suppresses discarded/garbage-collected section listings in the map; it does not alter garbage collection, executable semantics, native symbols, source or declared ABI.

proposed_delta: Add root-only -C link-arg=-Wl,--no-print-map-discarded; fresh output/watch directory and map path. All existing caps, GNU/BFD framing/nonemptyLOAD/exactlibc gates unchanged.
uncertainty: Does not establish new complete map fits16MiB, final image fits128MiB or links. Full produced map hash and LOAD associations remain required after a separately assigned successful attempt. Missing linker temporaries remain producer-trust limits.
